strategy.reason: Block_reassign can create/extend consecutive OFF blocks and break long work stretches (addressing both non_working_days_cost and consecutive_cost) while also allowing weekend-duty relocation from over-weekend nurses; it is less likely than block_swap to introduce illegal_succession because it doesn’t exchange shift types between nurses.
strategy.avoid: Avoid block_swap (repeated illegal_succession spikes) and avoid coverage_fill since adding assignments tends to worsen consecutive patterns and weekend/max-total pressure.
